verdict.rationale: Docs describe spawning multiple agents coordinated by a lead agent, running long-running/background tasks, scheduling recurring jobs, and parallel cloud sessions — directly matching the fleet/parallel/long-duration story. However, there is no hands-on evidence confirming multi-day autonomous fleet runs actually succeed reliably, and community reports cite failure modes, self-verification issues, and quality degradation on long autonomous sessions, so real-world reliability at scale is uncertain.
